zh-CN.title: 歌手头像框焕新
items: 四款歌手头像框加入专属场景与更流畅的人像动画，邓紫棋和陈奕迅的典藏头像框还有逐字演出。
头像框和个人名片按稀有度分组，每行展示两款。已解锁的新品会显示红点。

en.title: Singer avatar frames refreshed
items: Four singer avatar frames now have their own backdrops and smoother portrait animation. The G.E.M. and Eason Chan frames add animated lettering.
Avatar frames and profile cards appear two per row, grouped by rarity. A red dot marks new styles you have unlocked.
